items.reasoning: Using Objective Evaluation (Mode A), the agent accurately executed the prescribed 1 ps (2000-step) NVT simulation of 32 water molecules at 330 K with MACE-MP-0b3, obtaining a stable zero-dissociation trajectory and an O-O RDF first peak at 2.83 Å with height 2.16 (250-1000 fs average) rising to 2.70 (750-1000 fs block), closely matching the ~2.8 Å and ~2.5 target metrics. Beyond the baseline reproduction, the agent added valuable diagnostics including O-H/H-H RDFs, hydrogen-bond counts, block convergence, and correctly identified the condensation drift caused by the prescribed 12 Å box's low density (0.55 g/cm³). However, the RDF plots omit a full experimental reference curve overlay (marking only the 2.8 Å peak line), and the follow-up sensitivity run at 1.0 g/cm³ was too short (310 fs) to equilibrate.

items.reasoning: Evaluated under Mode A (Objective), the AI report and Figure 3 accurately reproduce the OH vs. O scaling relation across all six prescribed fcc(111) metals with a slope of 0.74 ± 0.14 (r = 0.93) and 0.80 (r = 0.97) for tilted global-minimum OH geometries, closely matching both the target plot (0.80) and the original paper (0.71) as well as the exact relative metal ordering. Beyond the target figure, the agent explicitly computes and plots the C vs. O non-correlation (r = -0.19), extends cross-metal validation to Co, Ag, and Au, and checks adsorbate site perturbations and bulk lattice constants. Minor limitations relative to the published paper include a ~0.3–0.4 eV offset in absolute energies from using the MACE-MP-0b3 checkpoint and plotting the theoretical γ = 0.5 scaling line rather than a self-consistent PBE DFT reference (slope 0.64).
